questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \oint\limits_{L} y^2 dx + x^2 dz &= \iint\limits_{\Sigma} \begin{vmatrix} dydz & dzdx & dx dy \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} & \frac{\partial}{\partial y} & \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \\ y^2 & 0 & x^2 \end{vmatrix} = \iint\limits_{\Sigma} -2xdzdx - 2ydx dy = \iint\limits_{D_{zx}} (-2x) dz dx - \iint\limits_{D_{xy}} (-2y) dx dy \\ \text{其中} \ D_{zx}, D_{xy} \text{分别为} \Sigma \text{在} zOx \text{面与} xOy \text{面上的投影区域，由} \Sigma \text{的对称性易知，} D_{zx} \text{关于} z \text{轴对称，而} -2x \text{为} x \text{的奇函数，所以} \\ \iint\limits_{D_{zx}} (-2x) dz dx &= 0 \\ \oint\limits_{L} y^2 dx + x^2 dz &= 2 \iint\limits_{D_{xy}} ydx dy = 2 \iint\limits_{x^2+y^2 \leq 2xy} ydx dy = 2 \int_{0}^{\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{2\sin\theta} r \sin \theta r dr \\ \text{故} &= 2 \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin \theta \cdot \frac{r^3}{3} \Bigg|_{r=0}^{r=2\sin \theta} d\theta = \frac{16}{3} a^3 \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin^4 \theta d\theta = 2 \pi a^3 \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解析：}\Gamma \text{所围成的平面块}\sum \text{为}z=2,x^2+y^2\leq 1,\text{方向向下。}\\&\therefore P=x^2yz,Q=x^2+y^2,R=x+y+1\\&\therefore \oint_{\Gamma}=-\iint_{\Sigma} (1-0)dydz+(x^2y-1)dzdx+(2x-x^2z)dx dy\\&\text{由于}\sum \text{在}yOz\text{面和}zOx\text{面上均无射影域，故}\iint_{\Sigma} dydz=0,\iint_{\Sigma} (x^2y-1)dzdx=0.\\&\text{而}\sum \text{在}xOy\text{面上的投影域为}D: x^2+y^2\leq 1.\\&\therefore \oint_{\Gamma}=-\iint_{\Sigma} (2x-x^2z)dx dy=-\iint_{D} (2x-x^2z)dx dy=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\cos^2\theta d\theta\cdot \int_{0}^{1}r^3dr=\frac{\pi}{2}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由斯托克斯公式} \\&\oint_{\Gamma} xyzdz=\iint_{\Sigma}\left|\begin{matrix}dydz&dzdx&dxdy\\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x}&\frac{\partial}{\partial y}&\frac{\partial}{\partial z}\\ 0&0&xyz\end{matrix}\right|=\iint_{\Sigma} xzdydz-yzdzdx\\&\text{其中}\Sigma\text{是平面}y=z\text{上以}\Gamma\text{为边界的圆平面，其侧面与}\Gamma\text{的正向符合右手规则。显然}\Sigma\text{在}xOz\text{坐标面上的投影为一线段。}\\&\therefore\iint_{\Sigma} xzdydz=0\\&\Sigma\text{在}xOz\text{坐标面上的投影为一椭圆}D: x^{2}+2z^{2}\leq 1,\text{且}\Sigma\text{的正侧方向与}y\text{轴成钝角。}\\&\therefore-\iint_{\Sigma} yzdzdx=\iint_{D} z^{2}dzdx\\&\text{令}z=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}r\cos\theta,x=r\sin\theta(0\leq r,0\leq\theta\leq 2\pi)\\&\text{于是}J=\frac{\partial(z,x)}{\partial(r,\theta)}=\left|\begin{matrix}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cos\theta&-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}r\sin\theta\\ \sin\theta&r\cos\theta\end{matrix}\right|=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}r\\&\iint_{D}z^{2}dzdx=\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{2}r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}rdr=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\cos^{2}\theta d\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}r^{3}dr\\&\therefore=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\frac{1+\cos 2\theta}{2}d\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}r^{3}dr=\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2\pi\cdot\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{4}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{16}\pi\\&\text{故所求积分}\oint_{\Gamma}xyzdz=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{16}\pi\end{aligned}
